# [S1] Extracts feature vector using pretrained CLIP model

The evidence explicitly states that the loss function Limg includes a term ||C(R) − C(Iprmt)||2, where C is a pretrained CLIP model. The text further explains that this term 'encourages TexGS-VolVis to match the global style pattern... by calculating the L2 distance between feature vectors extracted by the CLIP model C.' This confirms that feature vectors are indeed extracted using the pretrained CLIP model as part of the optimization process.
